data.question: Name three countries whose capital is named the same as the country itself, or the country's name plus 'City'.
data.explanation: Any three of: Singapore, Monaco, Vatican City, San Marino, Luxembourg, Kuwait, Djibouti, Mexico, Guatemala, Panama. Think city-states first.
data.answer_full: Any three of: Singapore, Monaco, Vatican City, San Marino, Luxembourg, Kuwait, Djibouti, Mexico, Guatemala, Panama. Think city-states first.

data.question: Julius Caesar crossed the Rubicon and was assassinated within five years. Was it the 3rd, 2nd or 1st century BC?
data.explanation: 1st century BC. He crossed in 49 BC and was killed in 44 BC.
data.answer_full: 1st century BC. He crossed in 49 BC and was killed in 44 BC.
